Low real-world cost (same file, same screen) — surface as a heuristic candidate.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/announcements/AnnouncementDetailScreen.tsx:176 — status pill renders raw backend enum via `announcement.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + announcement.status.slice(1)`; in an app shipping sk/cs/de/en/hu/pl, non-English users always see raw English ('Draft'/'Published'/'Archived') on a primary visual badge. Same anti-pattern as the already-landed fix `code-review-mobile-rn-outage-status-untranslated` (PR #3106 for OutagesScreen) — the omission recurred on AnnouncementDetailScreen. Fix: `t('announcements.status.' + announcement.status)` + 3 locale keys per language.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/voting/VoteDetailScreen.tsx:433 — `t('voting.notActive', { defaultValue: `Voting is ${status}.` })` interpolates the raw backend status enum into an English-only `defaultValue` template literal; the key `voting.notActive` is absent from `frontend/apps/mobile/src/locales/*.json` (grep confirms — only `title/activePolls/completedPolls/vote/voted/results/deadline/noPolls/submit/moveUp/moveDown/rankHint` exist under `voting`), so sk/cs/de/hu/pl users always hit the English fallback with the untranslated raw enum ('closed'/'draft'/'cancelled'). Correct form: `t('voting.notActive', { status: t(`voting.status.${status}`), defaultValue: 'Voting is {{status}}.' })` + locale keys.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/voting/VoteDetailScreen.test.tsx:1-100 — the only VoteDetailScreen test covers the Rules-of-Hooks early-return regression (missing-id vs rendered). `buildAnswers()`'s ranked default-ordering (VoteDetailScreen.tsx:221-229), the swap in `RankedQuestionCard.move()` (:596-602), `isAnswerComplete` across yes_no/single/multi/ranked (:204-213), the `answerRequired` Alert branch (:233-238), the castMutation payload shape (unit_id + delegation_id + answers), and the already-voted/can-vote banner states all ship with zero behavioural tests — a logic regression in the ballot would land silently. Pairs with the three-strike `repeated-churn` on the same test file.
